Let me set this out so nobody can say it wasn't clear.
1. Due 21 February. Arrived at my street 3 March. TEN days late.
2. ONE attempt. I was in. Nobody knocked.
3. Your driver PHOTOGRAPHED MY FRONT DOOR. I have seen the photo in the tracking. So he was there with the parcel.
4. The next day it is 'lost in network'. Lost where? Between my doorstep and his van?
5. 5 March: promised an email in 24 hours. NOTHING.
6. 7 March: promised an email by end of next day. NOTHING.
Do not tell me someone will be in touch. I have been told that twice. I want to know where my sewing machine is.
